modelIdentification.name: pyjevsim-dashboard
modelIdentification.description: Reference FOM for the Sensor → Dashboard object-instance example. One object class (SensorReading) with one published attribute (value). Distinct from the interaction-based FOMs in pyjevsim/ and pyjevsim-relay/ — this exercises the OBJECT half of HLA (register_object_instance + update_attributes + reflect callback).

objectClass.name: SensorReading
objectClass.semantics: An ambient sensor publishing one scalar reading. The Sensor federate registers an instance and updates the value attribute every tick; the Dashboard federate subscribes and accumulates the reflected sequence.

attribute.name: value
attribute.semantics: Monotonic-or-sine-wave scalar stamped by the sensor each tick. Decoded by the dashboard for verification.
